positive_terms: Explanation of relationship of significant CapEx and OpEx required to implement actions taken or planned to CapEx plan required by Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/2178
行动支出与分类法资本支出计划关联

Explanation of relationship of significant CapEx and OpEx required to implement actions taken or planned to CapEx plan required by Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/2178。行动支出与分类法资本支出计划关联。每个行动单独关联资源、期间和减排量；已实现与预期减排不可混同，减排量不是绝对排放量。
